THE EXAMINATION, EXPLAINED

Papers & components.

Choose the year you will sit the exam. The weighting applies to the qualification and route selected below.

EXAMINATION YEAR 2027ROUTE Exam route
Assessment components · 0500 · 2027 · Exam route
ComponentDurationMarksWeighting
PAPER 1Reading2h8050%
PAPER 2Directed Writing and Composition2h8050%

Paper 1 is compulsory. Choose Paper 2 or Component 3. Optional Component 4: Speaking and Listening, approximately 10–12 minutes, 40 marks; separately endorsed and excluded from the written grade. Coursework and speaking entries are arranged through your exam centre.

Reading — component 1+

Four compulsory questions: comprehension (20), summary and short response (20), language tasks (20), extended response (20).

Directed Writing and Composition — component 2+

Directed writing: 40 marks. Descriptive or narrative composition: 40 marks.

What you will be asked to do +

June and November series, with a March series in India. Grades A*–G. Cambridge suggests about 130 guided learning hours.

Paper 1 · Reading

Four compulsory questions, each worth 20 marks, use three texts totalling about 1,400 words.

Q1 tests comprehension of Text A. Q2(a) asks for a selective summary of Text B, up to 120 words (10 reading + 5 writing marks). Q2(b) is worth 5 marks.

Q3 uses Text C. Short answers and the 200–250-word language task are worth 10 marks each.

Q4 asks for a 250–300-word extended response (10 reading + 10 writing marks). It may be a letter, report, journal, speech, interview or article.

Paper 2 · Directed Writing and Composition

Section A is worth 40 marks. Q1(a) awards 5 marks for structured analysis. Q1(b) awards 10 reading and 25 writing marks.

For Q1(b), write about 250–350 words as a speech, letter, article or report that discusses, argues or persuades. The source texts total 550–650 words.

Section B is worth 40 marks. Write about 350–450 words on one of two descriptive or two narrative titles.

Component 3 · Coursework Portfolio

Three assignments of about 500–800 words each. Discuss, argue or persuade in response to reading (30 marks), describe (25), then narrate (25).

Include a first draft of one assignment. Your exam centre assesses the portfolio and Cambridge moderates it.

Component 4 · Optional Speaking and Listening

A 3–4-minute talk (20 marks) and a 7–8-minute conversation (20 marks). The separate endorsement uses grades 1–5 and carries no weight in the written grade.

In the same series, 0500 cannot be combined with 0990, 1123, 0472, 0510, 0993, 0511 or 0991.

A PURPOSE FOR EVERY LESSON

What you’ll work on.

01

Reading closely

Understand explicit and implied meaning, then select relevant evidence.

02

Writing with intention

Develop a clear response for its audience, form and purpose.

03

Precision on the page

Work on summary, sentence structure, vocabulary and composition.
